address_gate.behavior: Explicit Continue button; invalidated address hides estimator and request fields.

pricing.subject: Residential SiteSee Real Estate Quote
pricing.delivery: server-validated email; self-copy or sales@sitesee.ai preferred-date request with requester confirmation copy
pricing.photography_checkbox: Always checked, disabled and gray; enforced by quote engine
pricing.property_size_input: Synchronized number input and slider; both disabled at zero for Silver, Gold and Platinum; restore previous category and exact size for Individual Services
pricing.property_category_input: Disabled and gray for Silver, Gold and Platinum; enabled for Individual Services

package_matterport.controls: Independent number input and slider beneath Matterport; visible and enabled only when a package and Matterport are selected
package_matterport.individual_services: Continue using the main property area
package_matterport.quote_email: Include scanned area; omit disabled property size and category

pricing.package_photography_timing: Time to confirm because the main property area is disabled at zero; do not derive it from the saved individual area or Matterport subset
pricing.large_photography_status: Proposed $350 at 4000 sq ft through $425 at 5000 sq ft; $0.075 per additional sq ft. The $425 endpoint follows Luxury’s start and was not explicitly supplied for Large.
pricing.temporary_repair_workflow: Until pricing is fixed, start each new fix on a new branch and preserve earlier repair branches

residential_photography_interpolation.method: starting fee + (actual square feet - category starting square feet) * ((ending fee - starting fee) / (ending square feet - starting square feet))
residential_photography_interpolation.large_endpoint_status: Proposed from the adjoining Luxury starting price; not a recovered approved Large endpoint

pricing.photo_count_display: Residential category choices, selected photography service, quote summary and email; bundle-specific photo counts remain their included amounts

market_choice.name: property-type
market_choice.behavior: Separate hidden form panels; preserve selections within each market.

commercial.fields: Same required address, agent, preference and appointment fields as residential
commercial.subject: Commercial SiteSee Real Estate Quote
commercial.extended_term_premium: (photography + aerial + video) * 0.30 / 12 * max(0, total months - 6); first six included, 18 months total maximum
commercial.unlimited_basis: Property photography, aerial images and video only; exclude Matterport, individual 360 views, platform, website and floor plans
commercial.mixed_video_unlimited_license: Included in the 50% media licensing base

matterport_extended_hosting.formula: max(0, total months - 6) * selected monthly rate

commercial.photography: Automatically included by selected category: Small 750; Warehouse / Office 1200; Factory / Industrial 2500; extra photos charged above category allowance. No area-based photography pricing.
commercial.factory_rate_status: Fixed $2500 category fee plus extra photographs; previous $0.05 per additional square foot is removed by latest correction
commercial.matterport_area: Independent number input, 1 sq ft through category maximum; category changes clamp coverage only if needed

single_360_photos.disabled_until: Both Matterport and SiteSee platform selected

platform.excludes: Media licensing, Matterport capture and hosting

photography_quantities.additional_fee_basis: Only photos above the category included maximum

commercial.independent_website_selection: Services add-on checkbox synchronized with delivery radio; $175 charged once; available alongside platform
commercial.photography_timing_without_size: Range based on category minimum and maximum at 1.5 minutes per 1000 sq ft; add known scan, video and drone minutes to both bounds; round up to five minutes
commercial.quote_email_size: Omit exact photography area unless an optional exact size was explicitly supplied
